bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
echo CONTAINER_LAYOUT_BEGIN
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -c 'pwd; find /app -maxdepth 3 -iname "*startless*" -o -iname "*package.json" 2>/dev/null | head -n 25; node -v' || true
echo CONTAINER_LAYOUT_END
echo DB_TABLE_BEGIN
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=\x27public\x27 AND table_name LIKE \x27%startless%\x27"' || true
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE state=\x27published\x27"' || true
echo DB_TABLE_END
